mapper.insert: insert into ohfifthlane.report_tbl (user_id, rpz_id, report_image, photo_time, report_time, report_status, report_lat, report_lon, report_car_number, report_address) values (#{userId}, #{rpzId}, #{reportImage}, #{photoTime}, #{reportTime}, #{reportStatus}, #{reportLat}, #{reportLon}, #{reportCarNumber}, #{reportAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT rtbl.report_id, rtbl.report_image, rtbl.report_time, rtbl.report_status, rtbl.report_address, rtbl.report_car_number, utbl.user_name, utbl.user_tel, rpztbl.rpz_num FROM ohfifthlane.report_tbl rtbl join ohfifthlane.user_tbl utbl on rtbl.user_id = utbl.user_id join ohfifthlane.rpz_tbl rpztbl on rtbl.rpz_id = rpztbl.rpz_id where rtbl.report_id = #{reportId};
